title: TartanMsg
description: msg plugin for velocity and bukkit
body:
TartanMsg | Simple Cross-Server Messaging
TartanMsg is a straightforward messaging plugin designed for server owners who want a fast and reliable /msg system. It is a hybrid JAR, meaning the same file works on your Velocity proxy and your Paper/Spigot servers.

🚀 Why TartanMsg?
Hybrid Support: One single JAR file for both Velocity and Bukkit/Paper.

Network-Wide Chat: When used on Velocity, players can message each other across all sub-servers.

Wide Compatibility: Works seamlessly across modern and legacy Minecraft versions.

Privacy Toggle: Built-in system for players to enable or disable their private messages.

Fully Customizable: Easily change every message and prefix in the messages.yml file.

🛠 Commands & Permissions
/msg <player> <message> - Send a private message to anyone.

/msg <enable|disable> - Toggle your private messages.

Aliases: /tell, /w, /message.

📂 Installation
Velocity: Drop the JAR into the plugins folder and restart.

Spigot/Paper: Drop the JAR into the plugins folder and restart.

Configuration: Customize your settings in plugins/TartanMsg/messages.yml.

💻 Technical Specs
Optimized for high performance and low resource usage.

Uses Adventure API for high-quality text formatting.

No external dependencies required (all included).
